_comment: The first render longer than about a minute. Its purpose is to find out
what a 3-8 minute lesson actually costs in time and memory, since every
number in PLAN.md was measured on clips of roughly sixty seconds.
Known and accepted for this run: both Greek Piper voices are female, so
Serifis will not sound like Serifis. Casting is not what is being tested.
No music file is set — supply one with musicPath when there is one to use.
topic: The Swedish Vallhund, a small Nordic herding dog breed from Sweden. Everything shown must be dogs, Scandinavian farms, homes and green northern countryside. Never deserts, never cattle without a dog present.
